title: Welcome to Updates & Notices
body:
This panel shows announcements, new features, and important notices about FreeTV Garden.

**How this works:** edit `notices.json` in this repo, and new entries show up here automatically within a few minutes — no app update needed.

You can use:
- **bold** and *italic* text
- [links](https://freetvgarden.com)
- bullet lists like this one
